**Recommended one-shot formulation:**

- **Ethanol:** **49.0 v/v%**
- **SDS:** **0.75 w/v%**

**Rationale:**  
The best valid result so far was `34.555% ethanol / 0.752% SDS → 68.108°`. Since all measured values remain above the 65° target, the most rational one-shot move is to increase ethanol substantially while keeping SDS near the best-performing concentration. Extrapolating the observed downward trend suggests that moving from ~35% ethanol to near the corrected upper bound, while holding SDS around `0.75%`, has the best chance of lowering the contact angle into the `64–66°` target window without over-committing to maximum SDS, which has not consistently been optimal.
